footnotes_as_printed.a: m, mol salt per kg H2O.

pressure_note: not stated (isopiestic equilibrium at vapour pressure of the solutions)

value.what: isopiestic molality of CaCl2 test solution (mean of at least two parallel cups)

value2.what: isopiestic molality of the MgCl2 reference solution (mean of the triplicate reference cups)

value3.what: isopiestic molality of LiCl test solution; out-of-scope salt, kept

value4.what: isopiestic molality of CsCl test solution; out-of-scope salt, kept

composition.other_species: each column is a separate binary aqueous solution (not a mixture): MgCl2-H2O reference, CaCl2-H2O, LiCl-H2O, CsCl-H2O; LiCl and CsCl are outside the six-ion set

conversion_needs: none: molalities are mol salt per kg H2O
notes: Wide table as printed: one row per equilibrium run position (several runs share a row; blank cell = that salt not measured in a cup at that reference molality). Table continues on the next journal page and is concatenated (37 + 6 = 43 rows; the repeated header of the continuation is not a data row). The osmotic coefficients of CaCl2 are not tabulated; they would follow from the reference molality via the Valyashko et al. compilation. 43 rows: 29 have a CaCl2 value (in-scope pair with MgCl2 reference), the rest have only MgCl2 with LiCl and/or CsCl. Non-monotonic order in printed row pair 6.2994 / 6.2988 (MgCl2 molality) kept as printed. Mean values; reproducibility: MgCl2 triplicates max 0.10 percent, mean 0.04 percent; CaCl2 duplicates 0.06 percent.
quality_remarks: audit 2026-10-02: Each column is a separate binary solution equilibrated against a separate MgCl2 reference solution in a neighbouring cup (p.1066: '3 cups of reference solution and 9 cups containing test solution'); composition lists the test salt only, MgCl2 is the isopiestic reference (value2).
